goals: Keep StrippingToggle's existing client state as the sole supported master activation control for FallingTree while preserving FallingTree's native eligibility and tree-breaking behavior.
Preserve the accepted Canary 2 state-synchronization contract without adding a second toggle, hot-path compatibility lookup, or replacement tree system.
scope: Maintain the exact Canary 2 implementation represented by frozen legacy checkpoint f0101f38c446dddaa4226450386402c63597ba7c and implementation source checkpoint 8abd994b09a50879d0ae871d763f8c47248cc0f8.

Mirror StrippingToggle OFF into FallingTree's native fallingtree-disabled player tag and ON by removing that tag at join, local-player replacement, and state changes; clear the mirrored state on clean leave and server shutdown.
Keep FallingTree's former toggle command as a required exact status-only seam and keep all compatibility-owned work out of FallingTree eligibility, discovery, traversal, and breaking paths.
Retain exact C2 as the current and accepted client/singleplayer baseline and exact C1 only as the functional-pass/performance-fail comparison artifact, not as an accepted rollback release.

exclusions: Changes to StrippingToggle, FallingTree, their upstream binaries, or FallingTree's creative, required-tag, tree-detection, tool, enchantment, durability, drop, leaf, permission, and other non-activation behavior.
A second keybind, HUD, command, configuration, scoreboard, compatibility tag, UUID state map, periodic repair loop, tree traversal, or replacement FallingTree eligibility system.
Direct operator tag mutation and later FallingTree configuration drift; the accepted behavior contract requires sneakMode IGNORE.
Dedicated-server validation, which remains unperformed and is not inferred from the accepted client and singleplayer evidence.
Minecraft deployment, runtime-slot mutation, accepted-stack mutation, Test Instance Manager changes, Minecraft launch, and access to either gameplay profile during this migration.
Other projects, resource packs, runtime state, and originals content.
